substations_by_class.role_en: Link major power plants and the 345 kV north-south trunk corridors to 161 kV regional grids.
substations_by_class.role_zh: 串聯大型電廠與 345 kV 南北超高壓主幹線，並降壓轉供 161 kV 區域電網。

substations_by_class.role_en: Step down 161 kV sub-transmission to 69 kV sub-transmission or industrial feeders.
substations_by_class.role_zh: 將 161 kV 一次輸電降壓為 69 kV 二次輸電，供應區域變電所及大型工業用戶。

substations_by_class.role_en: Step directly from 161 kV to 22/11 kV distribution for dense urban areas and science parks.
substations_by_class.role_zh: 直接由 161 kV 降壓為 22/11 kV 配電，近年都會區與科學園區擴建主力。

substations_by_class.role_en: Step 69 kV regional transmission down to 22/11 kV distribution feeders.
substations_by_class.role_zh: 接受 69 kV 區域輸電電力，降壓為 22/11 kV 配電饋線供一般用戶。

resilience_plan.title_zh: 強化電網韌性建設計畫（2022–2032 年）

pillars.name_zh: 力求分散（降低電網集中風險）
pillars.details_en: Direct generation supply to science/industrial parks, local green-power consumption, decoupling Longtan/Zhongliao/Longqi 345 kV super-hubs, new urban substations (e.g. Daan, Wanlong), multi-tier CDCC/ADCC/DDCC dispatch.
pillars.details_zh: 電廠直供科學與產業園區、綠能分散就地供電、龍潭/中寮/龍崎三大 345 kV 樞紐節點分群、增設大安/萬隆等都會節點、精進多層級調度。

pillars.name_zh: 持續強固（設備更新與儲能）
pillars.details_en: Line capacity expansion & aging equipment replacement, grid storage expansion, indoor substation conversion to shield against extreme weather, salt mist, and wildlife.
pillars.details_zh: 汰換老舊輸配電設備與線路擴容、廣增儲能系統、變電所屋內化改建以降低颱風、鹽塵害與外力干擾。

pillars.name_zh: 加強防衛（保護電驛與動態監測）
pillars.details_en: Multi-layer protection relay coordination across plants and substations to isolate faults instantaneously plus real-time insulation/condition monitoring.
pillars.details_zh: 全面檢視電廠、變電所與線路保護電驛設定以建立防衛縱深、即時隔離故障點，並強化動態監測與絕緣診斷。

renewable_and_storage_kpis.note_zh: 中南部及東部光電熱區升壓與輸電線路擴建。

renewable_and_storage_kpis.note_en: Installed at key 161/345 kV substations to maintain voltage stability under high inverter share.

renewable_and_storage_kpis.item_zh: 全國併網型儲能實際建置（2025 年 7 月）
renewable_and_storage_kpis.note_en: 1.41 GW AFC/E-dReg utility/market storage + 0.01 GW behind-the-meter (printed p. 17).

renewable_and_storage_kpis.item_zh: 儲能系統政策目標（2025 / 2030 年）
renewable_and_storage_kpis.note_en: Plus new pumped-hydro projects under assessment at Guangming and Shimen (PDF p. 15).
renewable_and_storage_kpis.note_zh: 另推動光明、石門等新抽蓄水力計畫（關鍵戰略 PDF 第 15 頁）。

renewable_and_storage_kpis.item_zh: 需量反應抑低尖峰實績（2024 年）
renewable_and_storage_kpis.note_en: 934 MW traditional utility programmes + 380 MW aggregator bidding & E-dReg (printed p. 10).

renewable_and_storage_kpis.item_zh: 智慧電表 (AMI) 累計布建目標

renewable_and_storage_kpis.note_zh: 支撐時間電價與配電網即時資訊可視化（PDF 第 30–31 頁）。

renewable_and_storage_kpis.item_zh: 變電所 IEC 61850 數位化自動化累計目標
renewable_and_storage_kpis.note_en: Paired with 4,200 (2025) to 8,600 (2030) FDIR fault-isolating feeders and CDCC/ADCC/DDCC centres.
